payload.core_mechanism_summary: Convert dates to day-of-year indices, offset by 100. For each Olympiad, add its required people count to each day of its preparation interval (days before event). Output max over all days.
payload.rationale: The solution computes daily total demand via array accumulation; it performs no backtracking, state-space search, or combinatorial enumeration. Thus it doesn't align with the complete_search family.
